facts.text: I want to create a paraphrasing tool on my WordPress website with fully frontend and backend.
My frontend is written in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
My frontend has two boxes on the first page where the user enters text to paraphrase and sees the paraphrased result.
My frontend has a button named "Paraphrase" that paraphrases the content entered in the first box.
In my UI, the two boxes are along side each other and the button is under the first box.
My frontend UI and UX are advanced and the interface is good.
I want the backend to use NLP algorithms, machine learning, and a paraphrasing algorithm.
The frontend sends the user-entered paragraph or line to the backend for paraphrasing.
After paraphrasing, the backend returns the paraphrased content to the frontend to display in the second box.
The user can copy the paraphrased content from the second box.
My JavaScript frontend sends a POST request to the API URL "/paraphrase.php".
My JavaScript frontend appends the input text to the request using FormData with the key 'text'.
My JavaScript frontend expects the backend response as JSON and reads data.paraphrasedText.
My JavaScript code includes loading a T5 model using tf.loadGraphModel('path/to/t5/model.json').
My JavaScript code uses a Tokenizer to encode input text.
My JavaScript code uses model.executeAsync with parameters max_length: 50 and num_beams: 10.
My JavaScript code uses early_stopping: true and return_tensors: true.
I asked how to integrate the given frontend with the given backend code on a WordPress website page.
